Student Language: W13P2 Word Analysis

DS 2023  ·  Communicating with Data  ·  University of Virginia  ·  November 2026
LDA topic model (6 topics, 76 documents) applied to student responses about Nightingale's alternate charts. Word clouds are generated per topic using LDA word weights, and per chart type using combined term frequencies. Stopwords, common verbs, and domain-universal terms (chart, data, death, war) are removed to surface language that distinguishes how students reasoned, not just what they wrote about.
